description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00345926
Sheriff’s File # 26001880
PLAINTIFF – SCODB LLC vs:
DEFENDANTS- Hanning Family Real Estate LLC; Joeph M. Hanning: Jaclyn Anne Hanning
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 9th day of November 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in the Township of Middletown, County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey; the Borough of Union Beach, County of Monmouth , State of New Jersey; and the Borough of Keansburg, County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
136 Raritan Avenue, Keansburg, NJ 07734
55 Tulip Lane Red Bank, NJ 07701
408 Harrison Avenue Union Beach, NJ 07735
136 Raritan Avenue, Keansburg, NJ 07734
Lot 18, Block 47 on the tax map of the Borough of Keansburg, Nearest Cross Street: East Shore Street, Approximate Dimensions:50; x 50' (Avg)
55 Tulip Lane Red Bank, (Middletown Township) NJ 07701
Lot 9, Block 1031 on the tax map of the Township of Middletown, Nearest Cross Street: Navesink River Road; Approximate Dimensions: 82' x 189'
408 Harrison Avenue Union Beach, NJ 07735
Lot 4.01 Block 114 on the tax map of the Borough of Union Beach Nearest Cross Street: Stone Road, Approximate Dimensions: 50' x 90'
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of the Monmouth County Sheriff.
The sale is subject to unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water, and sewer liens other municipal assessments. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority.
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon. **If the sale is set aside for any reason, the purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The purchaser shall have no further recourse, against the mortgagee, or the mortgagee's attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $2,432,119.72.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: September 15, 2026
LaRocca, Hornik, Greenberg, Kittredge, Carlin & McPartland LLP
475 County Road
520, Suite 200
Marlboro, NJ 07746
